messages:
Maya: flagged during vuln triage: onprem keystore-agent v1.4.0 processed a decrypt where envelope tenant != caller tenant. repro in staging. tagging this as P2 but needs quick mitigation. @Liz can you take incident ownership?

Tom: can you drop repro steps + minimal logs?

Maya: repro steps: 1) generate svcacc token scoped to tenant-alpha and tenant-beta 2) post to /decrypt with ciphertext envelope indicating tenant-beta but X-Tenant: tenant-alpha 3) agent returned plaintext for tenant-beta

Maya: log snippet:
```
2026-01-15T09:12:03Z keystore-agent[pid=882] INFO req="decrypt" svcacc=svc-auth-qa caller_scopes=["decrypt:tenant-alpha"] envelope_tenant=tenant-beta request_id=xyz-789 outcome=allowed
```

Priya: immediate low-effort mitigations: - add envelope_tenant to structured audit logs (no plaintext) - emit a "mismatch_detected" event when envelope_tenant != caller_tenant (audit-only initially) - create SIEM rule for any allowed decrypt with mismatch

Alex: netpol: restrict keystore-agent egress to (1) internal-kms service (cluster-local) and (2) internal-metadata (for attestation). deny 0.0.0.0/0 at the nodes where agent runs. we also need sidecar egress-proxy to enforce TLS and mTLS to the HSM endpoint.

Tom: RBAC change: during authz evaluate envelope_tenant from ciphertext envelope, compare against caller scoped tenants. fail closed iff agent in "enforce" mode. Plan a migration flag AGENT_AUTHZ_MODE={audit,enforce}. rollout sequence: audit -> 72h log collection -> canary enforce in staging -> rolling enforcement.

Liz: I'll open INC-20260115-0123 and link this thread. owners: RBAC=Tom, Audit=Priya, Netpol=Alex, Runbook=Liz. target: audit-only rollout within 24h, canary in staging in 48-72h, full enforcement after 7 days.

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-20260115-0123 | Keystore cross-tenant decrypt (triage) | Severity: advisory | Owner: Liz

Priya: SIEM query suggestion (pseudo):
```
index=keystore_logs action=decrypt outcome=allowed | where envelope_tenant != caller_tenant | stats count by svcacc, envelope_tenant, caller_scopes
```

Tom: small K8s NetworkPolicy draft:
```yaml
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: keystore-agent-egress-tight
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app: keystore-agent
  policyTypes:
    - Egress
  egress:
    - to:
      - podSelector:
          matchLabels:
            app: internal-kms
      - podSelector:
          matchLabels:
            app: internal-metadata
      ports:
      - protocol: TCP
        port: 443
```

Alex: confirm that CNI supports deny-all egress semantics in our onprem clusters; if not, we'll use iptables-based host firewall as fallback.

Maya: test matrix for canary: (1) svcacc with exact tenant scope -> decrypt allowed (2) svcacc with different tenant scope -> in audit mode see mismatch log but allow (3) repeat in enforce mode -> expect deny and alert. add automated smoke checks to deployment pipeline.

Liz: will add runbook steps: how to flip AGENT_AUTHZ_MODE, how to roll back, who to paging. also update postmortem template.

Tom: note: avoid logging full envelope or ciphertext. only base64 prefix or tenant id. add ksm_request_id header propagation to correlate with HSM logs.

Priya: good call. include field "ksm_request_id" in logs and preserve request_id.

Maya: thanks team. I'll attach the repro bundle to INC and schedule a short follow-up sync after staging canary. :white_check_mark:
